patterns.note: Asymmetrical, organic layouts with large, flowing, hand-drawn lines that visually connect and separate content sections, breaking traditional grid rigidity.
Prominent use of a highly decorative, large-scale serif font for primary headlines, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text, creating a distinct editorial and artistic voice.
A limited, cool-toned palette of light blue, dark blue, and off-white, used in full-bleed section backgrounds, with black text and occasional vibrant red accents from imagery.
Scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, often accompanied by full-bleed background color transitions and a subtle parallax effect on the hero background image and decorative lines.
Numbered sections (01, 02, etc.) serve as prominent visual markers, introducing content blocks with large, expressive titles and often featuring client or project cards connected by organic lines.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely css-keyframes or a JS library like GSAP ScrollTrigger), where elements fade in and slide up as they enter the viewport. The hero background image and decorative lines employ a parallax effect, scrolling at a different rate than the foreground content. Full-bleed background colors transition smoothly between sections.

Large, SVG-based or image-based organic lines are positioned absolutely or relatively within sections, often extending beyond section boundaries and interacting with text and images, sometimes with z-index manipulation to create depth.

A display-style serif font is used for impactful, oversized headlines, often with custom letter-spacing and line-height, while a highly legible sans-serif is used for all other text, ensuring readability despite the artistic layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, decorative serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a mix of regular and slightly smaller sans-serif for body and labels, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards and buttons, with some elements like contact icons featuring full pill-like curves, contributing to a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with generous padding that allows elements to breathe, while some content groupings are more dense.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the integration of large, hand-drawn, organic lines that flow across different sections and interact with text and images, creating a unique, artistic, and cohesive visual narrative. This, combined with the expressive serif typography and asymmetrical layouts, gives the site a highly personalized and memorable aesthetic that breaks from typical grid-based designs.
